operations.title: The e6 quarter-lattice quotient is preserved by nodal transport
operations.body: For XY=p*s*(B-1), the primitive vanishing cycle eta and rho=eta/4 both have identity monodromy around p, s, and B-1. Their quotient D_e6=Z rho/Z eta is therefore a constant Z/4 local system on the labelled smoothing base. Deck acts by -1 modulo four. The integral three-face Gysin simplex remains a complex after extension to this quotient. This is a finite coefficient-lattice quotient, not physical cohomology torsion.

operations.title: Quarter-lattice transport and Gysin compatibility checker
operations.body: The checker verifies identity base monodromies, odd deck action modulo four, and d0*d1=d1*d2=0 for the labelled Gysin simplex.
